title: `parse_wheel_filename` accepts `playlyfe-0.1.1-2.7.6-none-any.whl` and returns bogus tags
spec:
This is the `packaging` library (Python 3, no dependencies; the code is in `src/packaging/`). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --ignore=tests/property` (about a minute).

```python
from packaging.utils import parse_wheel_filename
parse_wheel_filename("playlyfe-0.1.1-2.7.6-none-any.whl")
```
Expected: `InvalidWheelFilename`.
Actual: accepted, with tags `2-none-any`, `6-none-any` and `7-none-any`.

`packaging.tags.parse_tag` should reject such a tag too, raising `packaging.tags.InvalidTag` with "invalid interpreter" in the message.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
